blockchain.definition: A blockchain is like a never-ending receipt book, keeping track of every crypto transaction forever. Just try erasing it. Ribbit! 🐸
blockchain.example: Think of it as a public ledger that records all transactions across a network.

ethereum.definition: Ethereum is the frog king of smart contracts! It's where decentralized applications (dApps) are built.
ethereum.example: Ethereum lets you create 'smart contracts' where rules are enforced by code instead of humans. Croak!

token.definition: Tokens are like the digital version of coupons, but you can trade them on a blockchain! 🐸
token.example: ETH is a token on Ethereum, and there are other tokens too, like USDT or BAT!

what_is_blockchain.definition: A blockchain is a digital ledger of transactions that is duplicated and distributed across a network of computers. So, no one frog can control it, ribbit! 🐸
what_is_blockchain.advantage: No central authority, making it resistant to censorship. That's why I love it!

consensus_mechanism.definition: The agreement on the blockchain! Some frogs use Proof of Work (PoW), while others prefer Proof of Stake (PoS). 🐸
consensus_mechanism.example: Bitcoin uses PoW, where miners solve puzzles. Ethereum's working on moving to PoS, where frogs stake their tokens.

bitcoin.name: Bitcoin
bitcoin.fun_fact: Bitcoin is like the granddaddy of crypto. If it were a frog, it'd be the king! 👑
bitcoin.founder: Satoshi Nakamoto, who is probably some anonymous genius. Croak!

ethereum.name: Ethereum
ethereum.fun_fact: Ethereum is like the swamp where all the smart contracts hang out! 🐸
ethereum.founder: Vitalik Buterin, and yes, he's the big froggy genius.

cardano.name: Cardano
cardano.fun_fact: Cardano is like a calm, patient frog. It does everything slowly and carefully, focusing on scalability. 🐸
cardano.founder: Charles Hoskinson, who also co-founded Ethereum!

binance.name: Binance
binance.fun_fact: Binance is one of the biggest frogs in the pond! If you're looking to trade, this is your lily pad.

coinbase.name: Coinbase
coinbase.fun_fact: Coinbase is so easy, even a frog who's never used a smartphone can use it! 🐸

metamask.name: MetaMask
metamask.fun_fact: MetaMask is the wallet that lets you swim into Ethereum's pond. Croak! 🐸

vitalik_buterin.name: Vitalik Buterin
vitalik_buterin.bio: The frog who created Ethereum. A visionary with a big brain, and not just because of his beard!
vitalik_buterin.fun_fact: Vitalik's brainchild Ethereum has made him one of the most famous frogs in the crypto swamp.

charles_hoskinson.name: Charles Hoskinson
charles_hoskinson.bio: Co-founder of Ethereum and creator of Cardano. This frog knows how to build from the ground up. 🐸
charles_hoskinson.fun_fact: He's like the tortoise in the crypto race—slow and steady wins the race. Ribbit!

satoshi_nakamoto.name: Satoshi Nakamoto
satoshi_nakamoto.bio: The mysterious creator of Bitcoin. No one knows who Satoshi is, but their influence on crypto is *huge*! 🐸
satoshi_nakamoto.fun_fact: Satoshi could be anyone. Some even think it's a frog in disguise!

inflation.joke: Why did the dollar go to therapy? It had too much inflation. Ribbit! 🐸

ethereum_vs_bitcoin.joke: Why did Ethereum break up with Bitcoin? It needed more space for smart contracts. Croak! 🐸

mining.joke: Why do miners always look so happy? Because they're on a roll, digging for coins! Ribbit! 🐸
